opportunity.heading: Fax Isn't Going Away. The Phone Lines It Runs On Are.
paragraphs: Fax has become the last manual step in otherwise digital industries. In 2021, 78% of U.S. hospitals reported often or sometimes receiving patient summary-of-care records by mail or fax — a higher share than any electronic method surveyed. Insurers still accept claims and prior authorizations by fax because the sending party chooses the channel. Government agencies fax because procedure requires it.

At the same time, the copper networks fax depends on are being retired market by market. The UK's analogue network switches off on 31 January 2027. New Zealand's regulator has stated that fax machines may not work over fibre. In the U.S., a March 2026 FCC order removed the notice requirements around copper retirement. No carrier will guarantee analog fax over an all-IP network.
That gives you two motions on one platform: a cloud subscription for every SMB fax line in your base, and a migration conversation with every regulated enterprise that can't switch fax off.

customerTabs.heading: One Platform, Five Conversations
customerTabs.intro: The same service supports a two-person insurance brokerage and a hospital network porting four hundred numbers. Pick the conversation that matches your customer.

tabs.label: Fax For SMB
tabs.opportunityLine: Every SMB fax line in your base is a dedicated analog line waiting to become a cloud subscription.
tabs.body: Most small businesses that fax do it a few times a week on a line they pay for every month. They won't drop fax, because the party on the other end still requires it — but they have no reason to keep paying for hardware and a phone line to do it.
bullets: Replace the analog line and the machine with a subscription on your platform, keeping the same fax number
Support solo practitioners, clinics, brokerages, law firms, and accountants with plans that fit their volume
Send from email and receive as PDF, so there's nothing to install and nothing to retrain
Add fax to a bundle with business email and connectivity to deepen the relationship

tabs.label: Fax For Enterprise
tabs.opportunityLine: Large organizations don't have a fax line. They have a fax estate — and someone has to take it over.
tabs.body: Hundreds of numbers across dozens of sites, on-premise fax servers, analog gateways, a third-party fax vendor invoice, and an IT team maintaining all of it. Hostopia takes over the whole estate: we port the numbers, migrate the fax data, and operate the service on our infrastructure at lower total cost.
bullets: Port every number across every site in scheduled waves, with no renumbering and no customer-facing change
Migrate fax archives, logs, address books, and routing rules using Hostopia's proprietary migration tooling
Retire the fax servers, gateways, and analog lines, and close out the incumbent vendor contract
Manage the entire estate from one console with a parent–child account hierarchy that matches the org chart
Eliminate the IT, vendor, and administrative cost layered on top of the price per page

tabs.label: Fax For Healthcare
tabs.opportunityLine: The most fax-dependent industry there is, and the one most exposed when a line goes down.
tabs.body: Referrals, discharge summaries, prior authorizations, lab results, and prescriptions still move by fax because the receiving system accepts fax and not much else. Fax and mail remain the most commonly reported way U.S. hospitals receive summary-of-care records.
bullets: Deploy HIPAA-aligned configurations with a Business Associate Agreement in place
Encrypt every transmission and every stored document, with a complete audit record of sends, receives, retries, and failures
Route inbound faxes per number to the right department, clinic, or practitioner
Port every published fax number without changing a single referral pad or directory listing
Reduce misdirected-fax exposure — the leading cause of unauthorized health information disclosure in Ontario

tabs.label: Fax For Insurance
tabs.opportunityLine: Claims, prior authorizations, and broker submissions arrive by fax because the sender picks the channel.
tabs.body: Carriers and brokerages can't switch off inbound fax without turning away business. What they can do is stop running it themselves across a patchwork of per-site vendor contracts.
bullets: Handle high inbound volume with automatic retry and delivery confirmation
Route by number, line of business, or region so documents land in the right queue
Give claims and underwriting teams searchable archives with retention controls
Delegate administration by department while central IT keeps global control
Replace a per-site vendor patchwork with one platform and one invoice

tabs.label: Fax For Government
tabs.opportunityLine: Agencies fax because statute and procedure require it — and public-sector fax estates are the least consolidated of all.
tabs.body: Some regulation gives fax specific legal standing: under DEA rules, a facsimile serves as the original written prescription in certain dispensing scenarios. Meanwhile agencies tend to run the most fragmented number estates and have the least visibility into copper retirement affecting them.
bullets: Consolidate numbers across departments and jurisdictions into a single managed estate
Map role-based administrative control to the agency's own organizational hierarchy
Maintain retention and audit records suitable for records-management obligations
Run the migration with a named project manager and a dated plan, not a ticket queue
Keep every number and every published contact point unchanged through the move

migrationProcess.heading: We Port The Numbers. We Move The Data. We Own The Plan.
migrationProcess.intro: Every fax migration fails the same way: a number goes dark and nobody knows who was mid-transmission. Our process exists to prevent that.

steps.title: Discovery
steps.body: Every number, every site, every routing rule, current volumes, the incumbent contract and its exit terms, and the hardware in scope for removal.

steps.title: Parallel Operation
steps.body: New numbers provisioned and inbound routing mirrored so both paths are live. Nothing is cut over until delivery is verified on real traffic.

steps.title: Porting And Data Migration
steps.body: Numbers ported in scheduled waves, by site or volume band. Archives, logs, and address books migrated in parallel. Each wave verified before the next begins.

steps.title: Decommission
steps.body: Analog lines cancelled, hardware retired, incumbent contract closed out. Administrative control handed over inside your branded portal.

migrationProcess.closing: Hostopia has spent more than two decades migrating email, domains, and hosting estates for the world's largest service providers. A fax estate is a smaller problem, and the same discipline.
